description: Configuration of the SMTP server. Properties marked with "x-omit-in-collection": true (server connection settings and credentials) are omitted from collection GET responses
title: SMTP configuration schema

username.description: Username (credentials to access the SMTP server)

password.description: Password (credentials to access the SMTP server)

ssl.description: Connect to SMTP server using SSL

trustAll.description: Trust all certificates when establishing an SSL connection

expirationHours.description: Email gets deleted after this time from DB

from.description: Default sender address used when the email request has no 'from' field. Not matched against identities.

identities.description: When the value of EmailEntity.from matches the email address of a configured identity, that identity is applied to the From header, including its display name if provided. All email addresses must be unique.

name.description: Optional display name used in the From header (RFC 5322)

idleTimeout.description: Idle timeout for SMTP connection in seconds

connectTimeout.description: Connect timeout for SMTP connection in seconds

metadata.description: Metadata about creation and changes to the SMTP configuration provided by the server
